answer: By binding each identity to a bonded stake and a per-epoch non-collusive voting tree, the protocol makes a sybil swarm's marginal influence decay as narrowing canyon rather than a fable of unlimited cheap identities. Honest agents prove liveness through proof-of-stake quorums whose dynamic penalty curve rises with correlated equivocation, so a lagoon of fabricated peers. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
